title: ACORD 125 - Commercial Insurance Application
description: Canonical extraction target for ACORD form 125 (doc_type 'acord', acord_form '125'). A commercial insurance application: the party seeking coverage, the business it operates, the premises to be covered, and the coverages requested.

business_type.description: The applicant's legal form, for example Corporation, LLC, Partnership, or Individual, as marked on the form.

sic_code.description: The SIC classification code for the applicant's business, if given.

naics_code.description: The NAICS classification code for the applicant's business, if given.

years_in_business.description: How long the applicant has operated, in whole years, if stated.

annual_revenue.description: Stated annual revenue or gross sales, as a number without currency symbols or separators.

premises.description: The premises or locations listed on the application, one entry per location.

location_number.description: The location or building number as printed on the form.

address.description: The street address of this premises. Not the applicant's mailing address unless they are the same.

occupancy.description: How this location is used, as described on the form.

interest.description: The applicant's interest in the location, for example Owner or Tenant.

coverages_requested.description: The coverages the applicant is applying for, as listed or checked on the form.

$comment: AUTHORING NOTE - not injected into the prompt. On an application the party seeking coverage is usually labelled differently from how a bound policy labels it, yet it maps to the same canonical insured_name. That mapping is learned from training examples plus the field's semantic gloss - never from an alias list in the prompt, which would give the model a lexical prior and make confusable errors worse (arch 0c).
